result.topic_en: Ellipsoidal coordinates for the potential of a homogeneous ellipsoid: definition of the function t(s), its largest roots, and integral expressions for the attraction components X and Y.
result.transcription:
$t = s - \frac{s y^2}{s+\alpha^2} - \frac{s z^2}{s+\beta^2}$
$t - x^2 = s\left(1 - \frac{x^2}{s} - \frac{y^2}{s+\alpha^2} - \frac{z^2}{s+\beta^2}\right)$
[-x=-] $\sigma'$ größte Wurzel von $t=0$
$\sigma$ größte Wurzel von $t-x^2=0$
$X = \int_\sigma^\infty \frac{\sqrt{t-[-x^2-]}\, ds}{s\sqrt{(1+\frac{s}{\alpha^2})(1+\frac{s}{\beta^2})}}$
$Y = [-xf-] - \frac{xy}{\alpha^2-\beta^2}\int_\sigma^\infty \frac{(s+\beta^2)\, d\log t}{\sqrt{(t-x^2)(1+\frac{s}{\alpha^2})(1+\frac{s}{\beta^2})}} + 2\pi\frac{y}{\alpha^2-\beta^2}\frac{\sigma'+\beta^2}{\sqrt{(1+\frac{\sigma'}{\alpha^2})(1+\frac{\sigma'}{\beta^2})}}$
$1-$
